//: Copy this to llm-review.config.json (gitignored) and edit. ALL fields are optional — with no config the tool auto-detects a provider and reviews the one repo.
//provider: Which AI backend to use: "claude" (needs the `claude` CLI + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or "gemini" (needs the `gemini` CLI + GEMINI_API_KEY). Omit to auto-detect (claude, then gemini). Env override: LLM_REVIEW_PROVIDER.
//model: Model to review with, applied to whichever provider is chosen. Omit to use the provider default (claude → sonnet, gemini → gemini-2.5-pro). Env override: LLM_REVIEW_MODEL.
//providers: Optional per-provider overrides — handy if your CLI version needs different flags. bin = command name, model = model id, extraArgs = extra args inserted before the prompt.
//requirementsFile: Optional path (relative to the repo) to a requirements/spec file. The reviewer verifies the change SATISFIES it and flags anything unmet. Also auto-detected: REQUIREMENTS.md / docs/REQUIREMENTS.md. Env override: LLM_REVIEW_REQUIREMENTS (a path OR inline text).
//excludes: Extra git pathspecs to drop from the diff, on top of the built-in defaults (dist/build/out/coverage/node_modules/vendor, *.min.*, *.map, lockfiles). Use this for generated files specific to your repo. Git pathspec magic: '*' also matches '/'.
//crossRepo: When the repo being reviewed matches `match` (regex on its absolute path), also give the reviewer read-only access to `related` repos and steer it with `hint`. First match wins. Omit entirely for a plain single-repo review. Set contractOnly:true to pull related repos in ONLY when the diff looks contract-relevant (endpoints/params/schema/migrations) — keeps unrelated changes fast and cheap.

crossRepo.hint: CROSS-REPO: this frontend renders data from the api-docs repo and calls the backend. When the diff changes how endpoints/params are resolved, verify against the actual docs and backend contracts; flag mismatches.

CROSS-REPO: money movement. Verify amount/currency/rounding, idempotency (a retry must not double-charge), capture/void/refund state transitions, and that every money-moving endpoint is authorized. Check the ledger service and the API docs stay consistent with this change.
